recommendation: Training packet outline for the full invited cohort (32 participants): cover the three visible modules in a concise PDF with a title page, agenda, learning objectives, module-by-module sections, quick reference steps, and a closing Q&A/feedback page. Suggested structure: 1) Welcome and session goals; 2) Account setup — access requirements, sign-in steps, password/reset guidance, common issues; 3) Data handling — approved storage, sharing rules, retention basics, do/don’t examples; 4) Incident reporting — what to report, how to report, escalation contacts, response expectations; 5) Summary and resources — key takeaways, links/contact list, next steps. Format for all attendees: readable headings, short bullet points, simple diagrams or screenshots if available, and space for notes. Keep the content general enough for the entire cohort while still providing practical checklists.
